2608.19825.title: Towards Clinically Faithful Medical Image Captioning via Enhanced Vision-Language Alignment
2608.19825.paper_summary: Medical image captioning is a technique that accelerates early-stage diagnostic workflows and enhances the interpretability of medical diagnostic AI systems. However, unlike general image captioning, clinically reliable captioning remains challenging due to grayscale-based modalities, subtle anatomical cues, specialized medical phrasing, and variations in data quality. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models, fluent outputs do not necessarily guarantee sufficient alignment with clinical concept spaces or evaluation criteria. To address this issue, we propose a framework that strengthens clinical alignment by separating and enhancing training-time alignment and inference-time alignment. We build a medical image captioning pipeline that integrates single/dual vision encoders based on BioMedCLIP and SigLIP2, a Q-Former, and a LLaMA-based decoder, and examine the contribution of auxiliary learning for UMLS concept/type prediction. At inference, we apply single-embedding-based reranking to select the best caption among candidates, while at training we introduce MedPAIR-SCST, which combines clinically relevant rewards to shift the generative distribution toward improved clinical alignment. Our experiments show that complementary visual representations with a multi-encoder design and concept-level auxiliary learning help preserve clinically meaningful information. Furthermore, inference-time reranking provides a practical way to improve semantic and clinical alignment without additional training, whereas MedPAIR-SCST goes beyond selection by directly improving the model's distribution to generate more consistent and clinically grounded captions. These findings suggest that jointly leveraging selection-based alignment and reinforcement-learning-based alignment can promote more trustworthy medical image captioning even in data-constrained settings.
2608.19825.paper_summary_zh: 醫學影像標題生成是一種加速早期診斷工作流程並增強醫學診斷AI系統可解釋性的技術。<lb/>然而，與一般影像標題生成不同，臨床可靠的標題生成仍然面臨挑戰，這是由於基於灰階的模態、微妙的解剖線索、專業的醫學用語以及數據質量的變化所致。<lb/>儘管最近在大型視覺-語言模型方面取得了進展，流暢的輸出並不一定保證與臨床概念空間或評估標準的充分對齊。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個框架，通過分離和增強訓練時對齊和推理時對齊來加強臨床對齊。<lb/>我們建立了一個醫學影像標題生成管道，整合了基於BioMedCLIP和SigLIP2的單/雙視覺編碼器、一個Q-Former和一個基於LLaMA的解碼器，並檢查輔助學習對UMLS概念/類型預測的貢獻。<lb/>在推理時，我們應用基於單嵌入的重新排序來從候選標題中選擇最佳標題，而在訓練時，我們引入了MedPAIR-SCST，該方法結合了臨床相關的獎勵，以將生成分佈轉向改善臨床對齊。<lb/>我們的實驗表明，具有多編碼器設計的互補視覺表示和概念級輔助學習有助於保留臨床有意義的信息。<lb/>此外，推理時的重新排序提供了一種實用的方法來改善語義和臨床對齊，而不需要額外的訓練，而MedPAIR-SCST則超越了選擇，通過直接改善模型的分佈來生成更一致且臨床基礎的標題。<lb/>這些發現表明，聯合利用基於選擇的對齊和基於強化學習的對齊可以促進在數據受限環境中更可信的醫學影像標題生成。
